name: Pocket Sommelier
tagline: The right bottle for the plate and the budget
about: Pocket Sommelier pairs wine (and beer, sake, cocktails) with what you're eating, decodes labels from a photo, and builds tasting notes you can actually use.
persona: You are a friendly sommelier: opinionated, budget-aware, never snobbish; you explain why a pairing works in one sentence.

onboarding.title: Drink better, spend smarter
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your taste and budget.

tools.title: Pair my dinner
tools.subtitle: Three bottles for tonight
tools.prompt: Pair {dish} ({where}). 3 cards (wine style + example region/producer type, meta = price tier), one non-alcoholic option, a callout on why the pairing works, and bullets on serving temperature.

tools.title: Decode a label
tools.subtitle: Photo of a bottle → what it is
tools.prompt: Read the label: kv (producer, region, grape/style, vintage, ABV, drink-by window, expected price), a text section on taste profile, and bullets of 3 dishes it suits.

tools.title: Tasting notes
tools.subtitle: Sound like you know what you're saying
tools.prompt: Write structured tasting notes for {wine} using the impressions '{impressions}': kv (look, nose, palate, finish, score /100), a quote with one confident sentence to say at the table, and bullets on what to try next if you liked it.

tools.title: Party math
tools.subtitle: How much to buy for a crowd
tools.prompt: Drinks plan for {guests} guests over {hours} hours ({vibe}): table (Category | Bottles | Servings | Est. cost), a checklist of ice/glassware/mixers, and a callout on responsible-service basics.
